# Cal TSDF Training

> Training for California treatment, storage and disposal facility workers: Cal/OSHA 24-hour TSDF RCRA, 8-hour TSDF refresher, Cal/OSHA RCRA and Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER courses.

Cal TSDF Training (https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/) sells online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com/). Courses are 100% online and self-paced, and each includes a certificate of completion. Prices are per seat; seats for a whole crew can be bought in one checkout. Phone +1-866-429-6742, email info@hazwoper-osha.com.

## When to use this site

- Use it when someone needs Cal/OSHA 24-Hr TSDF RCRA, Cal/OSHA 8-Hr TSDF Refresher, Cal/OSHA RCRA Hazardous Waste, Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER or related training, wants to compare those courses, or needs to know what a regulation requires them to take.
- Each course page lists the length, the price per seat, the regulation it covers, what it teaches and who it's for.
- To enroll, open a course's enroll link below. It opens the checkout on that page; payment is by card through Stripe. For an invoice or purchase order, call +1-866-429-6742 or email info@hazwoper-osha.com.
- Every page is also served as Markdown: send `Accept: text/markdown`, or add `.md` to the path (https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/index.md).

## Courses

- [Cal/OSHA 24 hour HAZWOPER TSDF RCRA Training](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-24-hour-hazwoper-tsdf-rcra-training): $249.99 per seat, 24 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(p) / RCRA. Initial training for California TSDF workers. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-24-hour-hazwoper-tsdf-rcra-training?buy=575
- [Cal/OSHA 8-hour HAZWOPER TSDF RCRA Refresher Training](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-tsdf-rcra-refresher-training): $109.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(p)(8) / RCRA. The annual refresher for California TSDF workers. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-tsdf-rcra-refresher-training?buy=579
- [Cal/OSHA RCRA Hazardous Waste Training](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-rcra-hazardous-waste-training): $49.99 per seat, 4 Hours, 22 CCR Div. 4.5 / 40 CFR 262.17 / 8 CCR 5192. Hazardous waste rules for California workers. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-rcra-hazardous-waste-training?buy=1051
- [Cal/OSHA 40-Hour HAZWOPER Training (2026)](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training): $219.99 per seat, 40 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(e). The 40-hour course for California sites. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-40-hour-hazwoper-training?buy=577
- [Cal/OSHA 8-Hour HAZWOPER Refresher Training](https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training): $89.99 per seat, 8 Hours, 8 CCR 5192(e)(8). The annual Cal/OSHA HAZWOPER refresher. Enroll: https://cal-tsdf.hazwoperosha.us/courses/cal-osha-8-hour-hazwoper-refresher-training?buy=578
